item.title: security: Enhancing AI security through global AI red teaming
item.description:
Microsoft announced EXTRA, a global AI security initiative focused on AI safety research and red teaming. The program partners with universities, researchers, and regional experts to identify emerging AI risks and improve testing of frontier AI systems.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
